note: DFA Design for Asia Awards (香港设计中心). 数据来源为 POST JSON API: https://dfaa.dfaawards.com/en/lib/ajax/winner-dfa/list/ (params: keyword,year,design_category). design_category=3 = COMMUNICATION (传播/视觉传播设计, 含品牌识别/视觉识别/logo). 该站为AJAX驱动, 通用 scrape_award.py(Chrome+正则)无法消费JSON, 故用 fetch_dfa.py 抓取, 输出格式与其一致(年份目录+sources.csv). 每个项目取封面图1张, 避免同项目多张产品照/mockup.
